# Yogesh Modi — AI/ML Architect & Consultant

> Yogesh Modi (Yogesh Shivkumar Modi) is an AI/ML architect and consultant based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He takes AI systems from a rough, real-world problem to production — agentic AI, generative AI, RAG, computer vision and applied ML — with about five years of experience, owned end to end from architecture through QA to enterprise deployment. He is open to senior AI/ML architect and engineer roles and to select contracting and consulting engagements.

This is a single-page portfolio. Everything below is a section of the same page.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/): Introduction and positioning.
- [About](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/#about): Background, focus areas and the outcomes he points to.
- [Experience](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/#experience): Case studies, including the enterprise multi-agent AI platform, on-device vision accuracy for assistive smart glasses, and theft-detection activity recognition. Also lists certifications.
- [Projects](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/#projects): SMARTON AI smart glasses, an agentic shopping assistant (LangGraph + XGBoost), a two-pass spec summarizer (Gemini), and a natural-language SQL agent (LangChain over PostgreSQL).
- [How I work](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/#practices): The practices he applies to every engagement.
- [Affiliations](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/#affiliates): Products he is affiliated with, such as XWCare, a clinic operating system.
- [Testimonials](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/#testimonials): What founders and colleagues say about working with him.
- [FAQ](https://www.yogeshmodi.in/#faq): Short answers about his work, location and availability.
